registered_before_output.statement: No output of this job exists at registration. The job is queued only after this file's commit is on the machine and G-1 v5 has passed for that HEAD; the A-verifier checks CHECKLIST C3 (commit time < mtime of the first output).

soup.name: p1dev_soup3_s42s43s44
soup.meaning: The soup's weight update equals the mean of the three members' LoRA updates (delta space); no factor averaging and no norm-preserving variant
soup.self_check: before any decode, for the first and the last q_proj and down_proj modules, torch.allclose (default tolerances, float32) of the soup's update and the mean of the members' updates; the soup is saved with its sha256

data.split: train on KTVIC train minus dev300; decode, select and gate on dev300 only; no test look

data/datasets/ktvic/train_data.json.note: dev300 is a subset of KTVIC train; its 5 references per image are the dev gold

sft_rows.source: gold_p1dev/sft.jsonl as built by job 35_a (build_gold_sft.py --images-file data/splits/ktvic_train_minus_dev300.txt, default seed)
sft_rows.rule: the machine's copy must have this sha256

procedure.step0: Step 0, before any training or scoring: re-decode p1dev_s42 on dev300 on this job's machine (evaluate.py, short prompt, bf16, its defaults) under the name p1dev_s42_redecode. Every paired comparison uses this same-machine decode. Its agreement with the registered n2 decode (share of identical captions, CIDEr-D difference) is reported, never used to select anything.
procedure.train: job 35_a with only R and --seed changed: train_stage2.py --stage sft --data gold_p1dev --epochs 2 --seed <s> --loss-mask assistant (set_seed before the model is built) for s in 43, 44; the last checkpoint (end of training) only
procedure.decode: evaluate.py --model qwen2.5-vl-7b --adapter <run> --split dev_data.json --prompt short (NCS_DATASET=ktvic_dev, its defaults) for p1dev_s43, p1dev_s44 and p1dev_soup3_s42s43s44
procedure.mbr: per image, the medoid of the three members' greedy captions: argmax over a of the sum over b != a of rl_reward.CiderD(c_a, [c_b]), document frequencies from the references of the 3469 train-minus-dev300 images and rl_reward.Segmenter word segmentation (UPE-MBR's selection side, so the selection reads no dev reference); ties go to the lower seed
procedure.score: MBR captions are scored with evaluate.py --predictions; every system's per-image CIDEr-D comes from rl_report.dev_scores, which asserts that their mean equals evaluate.py's corpus value within 1e-6

analysis.delta: for v in {soup, MBR}: D_v = mean over dev images of [CIDEr_i(v) - (1/3) * sum over the three members of CIDEr_i(member)], word-level CIDEr-D x100

ci.method: paired percentile bootstrap over dev images

analysis.dchair: CHAIR_i(v) minus the mean of the three members' CHAIR_i, CHAIR-vi against the 5 dev references, in points (x100)
reported: BLEU-4, object P/R/F1 (ktvic5, exact classes), mentions per caption and CHAIR_i of every system, and as deltas vs the member mean
panel F1 on the 296 panel images (descriptive)
the members' spread of dev CIDEr-D
share of images on which all three members agree

frozen_predictions.source: manuscript/research_r14/R14_4/REPORT.md §3 A, stated there for the test look vs the member mean and registered here for dev300
frozen_predictions.applies_to: the carried variant vs the member mean

gate.eligible: variant v is eligible iff D_v >= +1.0 and dCHAIR_i(v) <= +1.0 points (point estimates)
gate.rule: PASS iff at least one variant is eligible; the carried variant is the eligible one with the larger D_v (tie: the soup, a single model); KILL otherwise

kill_rules.K2: every variant with D_v >= +1.0 has dCHAIR_i > +1.0 points

gate.status: a go/no-go gate, not a claim (PD-9 Q1)

consequences.PASS: the carried variant is the S1 component of the single final stacked-system prereg (PD-9 Q4); a confirmatory S1 number comes only from that registration's one test look (PD-9 Q5)
consequences.KILL: S1 is reported as a pre-registered negative; the test-pool proxy stays labelled exploratory
consequences.not_in_this_job: no test decode: R14-4's test evaluation of the p1assist soup and its K3 (test F1 drop) belong to the final prereg

test_look_ledger.what: MBR over the three p1assist seeds' test captions minus their mean, syllable-level CIDEr-D; an exploratory test look (PD-9 Q5), never used to choose the variant

disclosures: The R14-4 test-pool proxy was seen before this registration. It is a test look (PD-9 Q5) and plays no part in choosing between soup and MBR.
R14-4's proxy MBR used syllable-level CIDEr with test-reference document frequencies; the registered MBR uses word-level CIDEr-D with train-minus-dev300 document frequencies.
p1dev_s42 was trained on n2 without a revision pin. HF main of the base has not changed since its lastModified date, so that run loaded the revision recorded here (inferred, not logged).
Choosing the better of two variants on the same 300 images is optimistic. The gate is go/no-go only; the confirmatory number comes from the final prereg.
deviations: Any change after this freeze goes into a new dated file, committed through the gatekeeper before the affected output exists, and is reported as a deviation next to every number it touches.
